pilotResults.discoveryQuery: Monetary Policy Committee Sanjay Malhotra 5.25 repo rate August 2026
pilotResults.documentTitle: Monetary Policy Statement, 2026-27: Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) August 3-5, 2026
pilotResults.canonicalClaim: Repo rate unchanged at 5.25% under Governor Sanjay Malhotra; SDF at 5.00%, MSF at 5.50%
pilotResults.evidencePassage: Keep the policy repo rate under the liquidity adjustment facility (LAF) unchanged at 5.25 per cent.

pilotResults.discoveryQuery: Scale Based Regulation NBFC Upper Layer 2026-27 list
pilotResults.documentTitle: Scale Based Regulation (SBR): A Revised Framework for NBFCs - Upper Layer List 2026-27
pilotResults.canonicalClaim: 14 NBFCs identified in Upper Layer under Scale Based Regulation with asset threshold >= ₹1,00,000 crore
pilotResults.evidencePassage: The Reserve Bank has identified 14 Non-Banking Financial Companies in the Upper Layer (NBFC-UL) for 2026-27

pilotResults.documentTitle: Cabinet approves GOBARdhan (Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan) National Circular Bioenergy Scheme
pilotResults.canonicalClaim: Cabinet approval of GOBARdhan National Circular Bioenergy Scheme with outlay of ₹23,731 crore for FY27 to FY36
pilotResults.evidencePassage: Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved GOBARdhan (Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan) as the National Circular Bioenergy Scheme with a total financial outlay of Rs 23,731 crore for the period FY 2026-27 to FY 2035-36.

pilotResults.discoveryQuery: Micro Small and Medium Enterprises Development Amendment Bill 2026 Sansad
pilotResults.documentTitle: The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Act No. 16 of 2026)
pilotResults.canonicalClaim: Parliament passes MSMED (Amendment) Bill 2026; mandatory TReDS for CPSEs, 30 days arbitration referral, 90 days arbitral award, min 50% interim relief
pilotResults.extractedObservedValue: Arbitration referral 30 days, Arbitral award within 90 days, mandatory TReDS
pilotResults.evidencePassage: Section 18(5): Every arbitration award under this section shall be made within a period of 90 days from completion of pleadings.

pilotResults.discoveryQuery: SEBI consultation paper Credit Risk-o-Meter debt securities August 2026
pilotResults.documentTitle: Consultation paper on the mandatory adoption of a Credit Risk-o-Meter as an additional disclosure mechanism for debt securities
pilotResults.canonicalClaim: SEBI proposes mandatory Credit Risk-o-Meter with 6 colour tiers (Irish Green to Red) mapping credit rating AAA to D
pilotResults.extractedObservedValue: 6-level colour-coded Credit Risk-o-Meter (Irish Green to Red)
pilotResults.evidencePassage: SEBI proposes introducing a standardized 6-level colour-coded Credit Risk-o-Meter for all listed and proposed-to-be-listed debt securities.

pilotResults.discoveryQuery: Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme FAST-DS 2026 Income Tax
pilotResults.documentTitle: Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers – Disclosure Scheme (FAST-DS) Rules, 2026
pilotResults.canonicalClaim: Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme (FAST-DS 2026) under Finance Act 2026; window August 16 to December 31, 2026
pilotResults.extractedObservedValue: Window: August 16, 2026 to December 31, 2026; Valuation date March 31, 2026; Category 1 (₹1 cr) / Category 2 (₹5 cr)
pilotResults.evidencePassage: The scheme commences on August 16, 2026 and declarations may be filed on or before December 31, 2026. Valuation date is March 31, 2026.

pilotResults.discoveryQuery: DICGC Deposit Insurance coverage 500000 per depositor
pilotResults.documentTitle: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation - Guide to Deposit Insurance
pilotResults.canonicalClaim: Deposit insurance ceiling of ₹5,00,000 per depositor per bank under DICGC Act Section 16(1)
pilotResults.extractedObservedValue: Deposit insurance limit: ₹5,00,000 per depositor per bank
pilotResults.evidencePassage: Each depositor in a bank is insured upto a maximum of ₹5,00,000 (Rupees Five Lakhs) for both principal and interest amount held by him in the same right and same capacity as on the date of liquidation/cancellation of bank's licence or the date on which the scheme of amalgamation/merger/reconstruction comes into force.
